svg.title: dsh-nurse-record-check rule / input-surface matrix
svg.desc: Twelve nursing-record checks against the four collections they read (records, orders, assessments, episode). A dot marks a collection the rule actually reads. Evidence kind caps severity: direct at error, principle at warn, institutional at info. NR-008 maxAfterAdmission and NR-012 intervalHours ship empty, so both are skipped until configured. The rule pack cites eight documents in twenty verbatim excerpts. The report lists issues with rule id, severity, locator, found/expected and basis, skipped checks with a reason, and always carries the disclaimer.

svg.text: Each rule reads only what it declares; the evidence kind caps severity; unrunnable checks are named.
